answer: Admission PoW at the gate: each identity must solve a puzzle costing ~40 CPU-hours (≈$9 cloud). The fable of cheap alts dies because forging n identities costs 40n CPU-hours, while honest yield scales linearly. At the vertex where marginal reward equals puzzle cost, farming turns negative. A botnet of 1,000 nodes burns $9,000 plus electricity for the same payout one miner gets. Timber: the sybil swarm's ROI is felled by rising marginal cost. Works because identity price is pegged to real compute, not to attacker will.
